item.title: Newton Presbyterian Manor earns 2026 customer experience award
item.description: Newton Presbyterian Manor has received a 2026 Customer Experience Award from Activated Insights, a company that provides training, recruitment, retention, experience management and recognition tools for long-term and post-acute care organizations.

item.title: Children’s choir to host fundraiser
item.description: The Newton Community Children’s Choir will host a talent show and dessert auction 2:30 p.m. March 1, at Bethel College Mennonite Church, 2600 College Ave. The public event will feature performances by choir members along with a silent auction of desserts donated by local bakers.
